card.name: Drug effects lingering after stopping
card.fires_on: Words right after a drug or its effects that describe something staying behind, such as remain, persist, effects after 'residual', or 'from' after 'remain'. Seen in discussions of leftover drug action after discontinuation.

modes.label: Verbs of lingering
modes.description: Verbs like persist or remain saying a drug or its effect stays in the body.
modes.example: After discontinuation of fondaparinux sodium, its anticoagulant effects may<< persist>> for 2 days to 4 days

modes.label: Word after 'residual'
modes.description: The noun or word that follows 'residual', such as effects.
modes.example: Because residual pharmacodynamic<< effects>>, such as lowering effects on peripheral lymph

modes.label: Carry-over from prior drug
modes.description: 'from' linking leftover levels or effects to earlier medication.
modes.example: which may occur if serum levels of antihistamines remain<< from>> prior medication administration [see Drug Interactions

card.writes: It promotes words meaning residual, traces, and leftover, so the text goes on about something remaining.
card.plain: It lights up where the label says a drug's effect or levels may linger after the last dose.
